Under the extractor rules, 'other' is only for lines with nothing on the page explaining them, and a mixed line gets its dominant category plus a review. Donations/contributions (1920 + 1925 = 11,550, 61%) is the dominant part, so the line should be 'donations/contributions' with a review naming the mix (charges 6,724, refunds 550). It should not be 'other'.
